changes.before: A CLAUDE.md compliance flight-recorder for Claude Code. At SessionStart it parses CLAUDE.md into numbered atomic rules; on every Edit/MultiEdit/Write a PostToolUse hook (async, zero added latency) passively tallies how often each rule was relevant and whether it was followed or violated; at SessionEnd (or on demand via /dead-rules-audit:scorecard) it renders a worst-first compliance scorecard with a promote-to-hook hint for chronically-ignored rules. Zero deps, zero network, fully deterministic.
changes.after: A DipoleML.md compliance flight-recorder for DipoleML. At SessionStart it parses DipoleML.md into numbered atomic rules; on every Edit/MultiEdit/Write a PostToolUse hook (async, zero added latency) passively tallies how often each rule was relevant and whether it was followed or violated; at SessionEnd (or on demand via /dead-rules-audit:scorecard) it renders a worst-first compliance scorecard with a promote-to-hook hint for chronically-ignored rules. Zero deps, zero network, fully deterministic.
